sn1.5:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.5:2.1: Kati chinde kati jahe || kati vuttari bhāvaye || katisaṅgātigo bhikkhu || oghatiṇṇo ti viccatīti || ||
sn1.5:3.1: Pañca chinde pañca jahe || pañca vuttari bhāvaye || pañcasaṅgātigo bhikkhu || oghatiṇṇo ti vuccatīti || ||
